welcome_page.title: A Few More Details on Walking Safety
welcome_page.image_alt: #Person walking on a zebra crossing with a safety shield
welcome_page.description:
A few more questions about your safety on foot. Each question has two answers: Yes or No.

Participation is voluntary. Your answers are not linked to your name. If you give your email, we encrypt it straight away and do not save it: it becomes a participation code, so that your answers to different SmartUrbanity questionnaires can be analysed together. You can also answer without an email.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

questions.text: When you walk, do car drivers make you feel unsafe?
When you walk, do motorcycle or scooter riders make you feel unsafe?
When you walk, do bus drivers make you feel unsafe?
When you walk, do delivery vehicles (vans, cargo bikes, scooters) make you feel unsafe?
When you walk, do taxi or ride-hailing drivers make you feel unsafe?
When you walk, do cyclists make you feel unsafe?
When you walk, do e-scooter riders make you feel unsafe?
When you walk, do other pedestrians make you feel unsafe?
When you walk, do poor visibility or limited sightlines make you feel unsafe?
When you walk, does unsafe behaviour from drivers, riders or pedestrians make you feel unsafe?
When you walk, do crowding or conflicts with other road users make you feel unsafe?
When you walk, does the lack of safe or adequate sidewalks, crossings or lighting make you feel unsafe?
When you walk, does the absence of emergency services make you feel unsafe?
Do you feel less secure from crime or harassment where there are few people around (isolated or deserted areas)?
When you walk, do people behaving aggressively or in an intimidating way make you feel less secure?
When you walk, have you experienced or do you fear harassment because of who you are or how you look (e.g. gender, appearance, origin, age)?
Do blind corners or obstructed views make you feel less secure from crime or harassment?
When you walk, does poor maintenance (e.g., abandoned buildings, graffiti, broken infrastructure) make you feel less secure?
When you walk, does the lack of surveillance or security measures (e.g., no cameras, no staff) make you feel less secure?
Do previous personal or reported incidents in an area make you feel less secure when you walk there?
Do overcrowded or chaotic places make you feel less secure from crime or harassment?
On your walking route, are there steps or steep curbs without ramps?
On your walking route, are dropped kerbs at crossings missing or broken?
On your walking route, are there paths too narrow for a wheelchair, stroller, or two people to pass?
On your walking route, is tactile paving for visually impaired people missing or broken?
Would safer crossings and lower vehicle speeds make you feel safer when walking?
Would better street lighting make you feel safer when walking?
Would better separation from cyclists and e-scooters make you feel safer when walking?
Would sidewalks in better condition and better maintained make you feel safer when walking?

it.#When you walk, do car drivers make you: Quando cammini, chi guida l’auto ti fa sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you walk, do motorcycle or scooter: Quando cammini, chi guida moto o scooter ti fa sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you walk, do bus drivers make you: Quando cammini, chi guida l’autobus ti fa sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you walk, do delivery vehicles (va: Quando cammini, i veicoli per le consegne (furgoni, cargo bike, scooter) ti fanno sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you walk, do taxi or ride-hailing: Quando cammini, chi guida taxi o servizi di ride-hailing ti fa sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you walk, do cyclists make you fee: Quando cammini, chi va in bicicletta ti fa sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you walk, do e-scooter riders make: Quando cammini, chi va in monopattino elettrico ti fa sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you walk, do other pedestrians mak: Quando cammini, altre persone a piedi ti fanno sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you walk, do poor visibility or li: Quando cammini, la scarsa visibilità o la visuale limitata ti fanno sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you walk, does unsafe behaviour fr: Quando cammini, i comportamenti pericolosi di chi guida, di chi pedala o di chi va a piedi ti fanno sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you walk, do crowding or conflicts: Quando cammini, l’affollamento o i conflitti con altri utenti della strada ti fanno sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you walk, does the lack of safe or: Quando cammini, la mancanza di marciapiedi, attraversamenti o illuminazione sicuri e adeguati ti fa sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you walk, does the absence of emer: Quando cammini, l’assenza di servizi di emergenza ti fa sentire in pericolo?
it.#Do you feel less secure from crime or h: Ti senti meno al sicuro da reati o molestie dove c’è poca gente (zone isolate o deserte)?
it.#When you walk, do people behaving aggre: Quando cammini, le persone che si comportano in modo aggressivo o intimidatorio ti fanno sentire meno al sicuro?
it.#When you walk, have you experienced or: Quando cammini, hai subito o temi molestie per chi sei o per come appari (es. genere, aspetto, origine, età)?
it.#Do blind corners or obstructed views ma: Gli angoli ciechi o la visuale ostruita ti fanno sentire meno al sicuro da reati o molestie?
it.#When you walk, does poor maintenance (e: Quando cammini, la scarsa manutenzione (es. edifici abbandonati, graffiti, infrastrutture rotte) ti fa sentire meno al sicuro?
it.#When you walk, does the lack of surveil: Quando cammini, la mancanza di sorveglianza o di misure di sicurezza (es. niente telecamere, niente personale) ti fa sentire meno al sicuro?
it.#Do previous personal or reported incide: Episodi accaduti a te o segnalati in una zona ti fanno sentire meno al sicuro quando ci cammini?
it.#Do overcrowded or chaotic places make y: I luoghi sovraffollati o caotici ti fanno sentire meno al sicuro da reati o molestie?
it.#On your walking route, are there steps: Sul tuo percorso a piedi ci sono gradini o cordoli alti senza rampe?
it.#On your walking route, are dropped kerb: Sul tuo percorso a piedi mancano o sono rotti gli scivoli dei marciapiedi agli attraversamenti?
it.#On your walking route, are there paths: Sul tuo percorso a piedi ci sono passaggi troppo stretti per una sedia a rotelle, un passeggino o due persone?
it.#On your walking route, is tactile pavin: Sul tuo percorso a piedi i percorsi tattili per persone con disabilità visiva mancano o sono rotti?
it.#Would safer crossings and lower vehicle: Attraversamenti più sicuri e velocità dei veicoli più basse ti farebbero sentire più al sicuro a piedi?
it.#Would better street lighting make you f: Un’illuminazione stradale migliore ti farebbe sentire più al sicuro a piedi?
it.#Would better separation from cyclists a: Una migliore separazione da biciclette e monopattini elettrici ti farebbe sentire più al sicuro a piedi?
it.#Would sidewalks in better condition and: Marciapiedi in condizioni migliori e con più manutenzione ti farebbero sentire più al sicuro a piedi?
it.#<p>A few more questions about your safe:
Qualche domanda in più sulla tua sicurezza a piedi. Ogni domanda ha due risposte: Sì o No.

La partecipazione è volontaria. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome. Se lasci la tua email, la cifriamo subito e non la salviamo: diventa un codice di partecipazione, così le risposte ai diversi questionari SmartUrbanity possono essere analizzate insieme. Puoi rispondere anche senza email.

Scopri di più su SmartUrbanity
it.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: La tua risposta è stata registrata. Grazie per il tempo dedicato alla compilazione del questionario.

fr.#SmartUrbanity - Walking Safety: More De: SmartUrbanity - Sécurité à pied : quelques détails de plus
fr.#Walking Safety: More Details: Sécurité à pied : quelques détails de plus
fr.#A Few More Details on Walking Safety: Quelques détails de plus sur la sécurité à pied
fr.#When you walk, do car drivers make you: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause des personnes qui conduisent une voiture ?
fr.#When you walk, do motorcycle or scooter: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause des personnes à moto ou en scooter ?
fr.#When you walk, do bus drivers make you: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause des personnes qui conduisent un bus ?
fr.#When you walk, do delivery vehicles (va: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause des véhicules de livraison (fourgonnettes, vélos cargo, scooters) ?
fr.#When you walk, do taxi or ride-hailing: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause des personnes qui conduisent un taxi ou un VTC ?
fr.#When you walk, do cyclists make you fee: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause des cyclistes ?
fr.#When you walk, do e-scooter riders make: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause des personnes en trottinette électrique ?
fr.#When you walk, do other pedestrians mak: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause d’autres personnes à pied ?
fr.#When you walk, do poor visibility or li: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause d’une mauvaise visibilité ou d’un champ de vision limité ?
fr.#When you walk, does unsafe behaviour fr: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause de comportements dangereux de personnes qui conduisent, qui roulent ou qui marchent ?
fr.#When you walk, do crowding or conflicts: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause de la foule ou de conflits avec d’autres personnes sur la route ?
fr.#When you walk, does the lack of safe or: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause du manque de trottoirs, de passages ou d’éclairage sûrs et adaptés ?
fr.#When you walk, does the absence of emer: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause de l’absence de services d’urgence ?
fr.#Do you feel less secure from crime or h: Vous sentez-vous moins à l’abri de la criminalité ou du harcèlement là où il y a peu de monde (zones isolées ou désertes) ?
fr.#When you walk, do people behaving aggre: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous moins en sécurité à cause de personnes au comportement agressif ou intimidant ?
fr.#When you walk, have you experienced or: Lorsque vous marchez, avez-vous subi ou redoutez-vous du harcèlement en raison de qui vous êtes ou de votre aspect (par ex. genre, apparence, origine, âge) ?
fr.#Do blind corners or obstructed views ma: Vous sentez-vous moins à l’abri de la criminalité ou du harcèlement à cause des angles morts ou des vues obstruées ?
fr.#When you walk, does poor maintenance (e: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous moins en sécurité à cause d’un mauvais entretien (par ex. bâtiments abandonnés, graffitis, infrastructures dégradées) ?
fr.#When you walk, does the lack of surveil: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous moins en sécurité à cause du manque de surveillance ou de mesures de sécurité (par ex. pas de caméras, pas de personnel) ?
fr.#Do previous personal or reported incide: Vous sentez-vous moins en sécurité lorsque vous marchez dans un quartier où des incidents vous sont arrivés ou ont été signalés ?
fr.#Do overcrowded or chaotic places make y: Vous sentez-vous moins à l’abri de la criminalité ou du harcèlement dans les lieux bondés ou chaotiques ?
fr.#On your walking route, are there steps: Sur votre trajet à pied, y a-t-il des marches ou des bordures hautes sans rampe ?
fr.#On your walking route, are dropped kerb: Sur votre trajet à pied, les bateaux de trottoir aux passages piétons manquent-ils ou sont-ils abîmés ?
fr.#On your walking route, are there paths: Sur votre trajet à pied, y a-t-il des passages trop étroits pour un fauteuil roulant, une poussette ou deux personnes ?
fr.#On your walking route, is tactile pavin: Sur votre trajet à pied, les bandes podotactiles pour les personnes malvoyantes manquent-elles ou sont-elles abîmées ?
fr.#What Would Make Walking Safer: Ce qui rendrait la marche plus sûre
fr.#Would safer crossings and lower vehicle: Des passages plus sûrs et une vitesse des véhicules réduite vous feraient-ils sentir plus en sécurité à pied ?
fr.#Would better street lighting make you f: Un meilleur éclairage public vous ferait-il sentir plus en sécurité à pied ?
fr.#Would better separation from cyclists a: Une meilleure séparation avec les vélos et les trottinettes électriques vous ferait-elle sentir plus en sécurité à pied ?
fr.#Would sidewalks in better condition and: Des trottoirs en meilleur état et mieux entretenus vous feraient-ils sentir plus en sécurité à pied ?
fr.#<p>A few more questions about your safe:
Quelques questions de plus sur votre sécurité à pied. Chaque question a deux réponses : Oui ou Non.

La participation est volontaire. Vos réponses ne sont pas associées à votre nom. Si vous indiquez votre adresse e-mail, nous la chiffrons immédiatement et ne l’enregistrons pas : elle devient un code de participation, afin que vos réponses aux différents questionnaires SmartUrbanity puissent être analysées ensemble. Vous pouvez aussi répondre sans adresse e-mail.

En savoir plus sur SmartUrbanity
fr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Votre réponse a bien été enregistrée. Merci d’avoir pris le temps de remplir ce questionnaire.
